rationale: All tight-target runs (9.1-10.9 ns) closed with positive reg-to-reg slack at ss 100C max-RC, so T_eff just tracks the target and the limit is not yet found. The loose runs are limited by I/O-port paths. Hold (+0.08 ns, few buffers), slew/cap (at most 101 vs bar 953) and DRC (final 0) do not limit anything, so push timing: pin the period floor (0.45 = 8.49 ns) and raise setup margins to aim below it. cap213 plus post-GRT timing repair kept the most signoff slack (+0.55 ns, runs 002/005), while stock RC lost margin after routing (008). DELAY 4 gave the best T_eff. 30% utilisation leaves room for more repair buffers. Other knobs are left free to explore.
